content.title: Pi Day 2026: Full list of pizza and pie deals at Pizza Hut and more
content.text: PublishedMar 14, 2026 at 06:00 AM EDTRestaurants, convenience chains and delivery apps across the country are marking National Pi Day on March 14 with discounts on pizzas, dessert pies and other circular foods. From 7-Eleven to Sheetz, multiple national chains are joining in on the offers.The date, written as 3/14, references the mathematical constant pi that starts with 3.14, and has become a promotional opportunity for pizzerias, bakeries and delivery platforms looking to increase foot traffic with limited‑time pricing and loyalty incentives.What Is Pi Day?Pi Day has evolved into a nationwide retail event that helps restaurants boost sales by pairing math‑themed branding with recognizable price points such as $3.14. The U.S. House of Representatives recognized March 14 as National Pi Day in 2009. For the second year in a row, Newsweek is providing a rundown of the chains that are using the holiday to roll out temporary deals, encourage bundled orders and trial of new menu items.Stock Image: Close up image of shot hands grabbing slices of pizza. | Getty Images/DeagreezList of Pi Day Deals Available Across the US7‑Eleven, Speedway and Stripes are offering whole pizzas for $3.14 to 7Rewards and Speedy Rewards members in stores and via the 7NOW app on March 13 and 14. Speedy Café features a large one‑topping pizza for $3.14 at participating locations during the same two‑day promotion.DiGiorno is giving away 314 free pizzas via a social media competition. Participants who follow the platform and tag friends on Instagram may be entered into a contest for a free pie.Pizza Hut is offering a $10 large three-topping pizza deal for Pi Day, according to a press release. Customers can order at participating locations nationwide while supplies last.DoorDash is offering several deals from popular chains like Pizza Hut, Sbarro and Blaze Pizza, according to a press release. DoorDash is running a buy‑one‑get‑one (BOGO) free deal on medium or large Create Your Own pizzas on March 14 for Pizza Hut eaters. For Sbarro orders, DoorDash offers $4 off orders of $20 or more through April 6, with DashPass members receiving $5 off $25 or more. And Blaze Pizza, via DoorDash, offers a buy‑one‑get‑one free Simple Pie 11‑inch cheese pizza through April 6.Burger King offers Royal Perks members a free Hershey’s Sundae Pie or Cinnamon Apple Pie with a $3.14 purchase on March 14 through its app or website.Blaze Pizza runs a one‑day, in‑restaurant deal to buy one 11‑inch pizza and get a second for $3.14, with a digital BOGO code provided for future use.Round Table Pizza offers Royal Rewards members a one‑topping personal pizza for $3.14 with the purchase of a large or extra‑large pizza, according to a press release. Marco’s Pizza sells a medium one‑topping pizza for $3.14 with the purchase of a large or extra‑large pizza using the code PIDAY, according to a Food Network roundup.BJ’s Restaurant & Brewhouse offers a "Pizookie" dessert for $3.14 with the purchase of a large or shareable pizza for dine‑in guests.Anthony’s Coal Fired Pizza & Wings sells a 10‑inch coal‑fired cheese pizza for $3.14 with any beverage purchase through 4 p.m. local time for dine‑in guests who mention the offer. Mountain Mike’s runs a member BOGO deal with $3.14 pricing on the second, one-topping pizza.PLNT Burger offers Crispy Herb Fries for $3.14 with a digital code, according to a Food Network roundup.Polly’s Pies offer dine-in guests a free slice of pie with the purchase of any entree, and royalty members who dine-in can enjoy a free slice at no additional cost, according to a press release. Goldbelly runs discounts of up to 31.4 percent on select pies.Grimaldi’s sells $3.14 pizza giant slices at participating locations, from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m.Sheetz is offering cheese and pepperoni pizza flatz for $3.14 via its app from March 14 through March 20. Food app Wonder is promoting a Pi Day bundle available until March 14. Guests who purchase any Detroit Brick Pizza can get a free Four & Twenty Blackbirds Coffee Custard Pie discounted, according to a company press email provided to Newsweek.
